The empty walk has total weight $$$0$$$.
For every vertex $$$v$$$, let $$$\mathrm{dist}(v)$$$ be the minimum total weight among all walks from vertex $$$1$$$ to vertex $$$v$$$. If no such walk exists, $$$\mathrm{dist}(v)$$$ is undefined.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$T$$$ ($$$1\le T\le10^4$$$), the number of test cases.

The first line contains three integers $$$n$$$, $$$m$$$, and $$$k$$$ ($$$1\le n\le2\times10^5$$$, $$$0\le m\le5\times10^5$$$, $$$1\le k\le10^9$$$), denoting the number of vertices, the number of edges, and the parameter used in the definition of total weight, respectively.

Each of the next $$$m$$$ lines contains three integers $$$u$$$, $$$v$$$, and $$$w$$$ ($$$1\le u,v\le n$$$, $$$u\ne v$$$, $$$0\le w \lt k$$$), denoting an undirected edge between vertices $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ with weight $$$w$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2\times10^5$$$, and the sum of $$$m$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$5\times10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print one line containing $$$n$$$ integers. For each $$$1\le i\le n$$$, consider the $$$i$$$-th integer. If $$$\mathrm{dist}(i)$$$ is defined, it must be $$$\mathrm{dist}(i)$$$ modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$; otherwise, it must be $$$-1$$$.
note: In the sample, the empty walk gives $$$\mathrm{dist}(1)=0$$$. The one-edge walks give $$$\mathrm{dist}(2)=1$$$ and $$$\mathrm{dist}(3)=2$$$.

There are two two-edge walks from vertex $$$1$$$ to vertex $$$4$$$. Their total weights are $$$1\cdot3+0=3$$$ and $$$2\cdot3+0=6$$$, so $$$\mathrm{dist}(4)=3$$$. Vertex $$$5$$$ is unreachable from vertex $$$1$$$.

接下来的每一行$$$m$$$包含三个整数$$$u$$$， $$$v$$$和$$$w$$$ ($$$1\le u,v\le n$$$, $$$u\ne v$$$, $$$0\le w \lt k$$$)，表示顶点$$$u$$$和$$$v$$$之间的无向边，权值为$$$w$$$。
